records.text: The 山 entry calls the graph pictographic and says it depicts many mountain peaks standing together. It describes Shang oracle-bone forms as outlines of mountains, and Shang and Western Zhou bronze forms as varied—filled or outlined, three or five peaks. It describes subsequent stylization, and gives the basic sense as a high, pointed part of the ground. It cites 《合集》96 and examples from the *Shijing* and *Xunzi*. I inspected the supplied original scan pixels on both pages; the 山 entry ends on printed p. 810 and does not continue on p. 811. The checked prose and references match the provisional OCR; no 山-entry OCR correction was found. Bibliography: 李學勤主編,《字源》, 天津古籍出版社 / 遼寧人民出版社, 2012, ISBN 9787552800692. Scan occurrence and checked forms: PDF p. 823, 山 headword and passage from “象形字。像众多山峰耸立” through “《荀子·赋》”; PDF p. 824 checked to distinguish adjacent entries and verify no continuation.
